dialogue.content: (こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願い致します。時間になったら初めてよろしいでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for being here today. Shall we begin when it's time?)

dialogue.content: (こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。はい。大丈夫です。何か希望はありますか？)
dialogue.English: (Good evening. The pleasure is all mine. Yes, that's fine. Do you have any preferences?)

dialogue.content: （希望は特にないです。ありがとうございます。)
dialogue.English: (I don't have any particular preferences. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (かしこまりました。)
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。よろしくお願い致します。始めに、ご年齢と性別、今日のご相談内容を教えて下さい。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 42歳女家族に鬱陶しがられてます。
dialogue.English: I'm a 42-year-old woman, and my family finds me annoying.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、それはいつからでしょうか？また、何かきっかけなどはおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. How long has this been going on? Is there any particular trigger or event that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: ここ数年です。
dialogue.English: For the past few years.

dialogue.content: きっかけが分からないので困っています。
dialogue.English: I'm troubled because I don't know what triggered it.

dialogue.content: 朝ごはんの支度してもみんな忙しいって言って食べないこととか多くて
dialogue.English: For example, when I prepare breakfast, they often say they're busy and don't eat.

dialogue.content: 私は何をしているのか分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know what I'm doing all this for.

dialogue.content: 私が何か悪いことしたんですかね？
dialogue.English: Did I do something wrong?

dialogue.content: なるほど、数年もの間感じられているのですね。心当たりがないと、困ってしまいますよね。日々、ご家族のために作られているのですものね。大変ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you've been feeling this way for several years now. It must be distressing when you have no idea what could be the cause. After all, you're making meals for your family every day. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: ご家族構成を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me who is in your family?

dialogue.content: 旦那と娘と息子です。
dialogue.English: My husband, daughter, and son.

dialogue.content: 娘は高校3年生で息子は中学3年生です。
dialogue.English: My daughter is in her third year of high school, and my son is in his third year of middle school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お子さん達は実際お忙しいのでしょうか？状況を少し伺えればと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are your children actually busy? I'd like to understand the situation a little more.

dialogue.content: 2人とも受験生ですからね。忙しいとは思います。
dialogue.English: They're both preparing for entrance exams, you know. So I do think they're busy.

dialogue.content: ですが、今に始まったことではなくここ数年態度が冷たいので受験のせいだけではないと思っています。
dialogue.English: However, this isn't something new; their attitude has been cold for the past few years, so I don't think it's only because of the exams.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと晩御飯は夜食も用意して何かあった時にフォローしてあげられるようにしてるんですが。。
dialogue.English: I make sure to prepare dinner and even a late-night snack so I can be there to support them if anything comes up, but...

dialogue.content: ↑晩御飯や夜食も用意して
dialogue.English: ↑ I mean, I prepare dinner and late-night snacks.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、受験だけの問題ではないのですね。
dialogue.English: I see; it's not just about the exams.

dialogue.content: お子さん達の事を考えていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: You're really thinking about your children's needs.

dialogue.content: 態度が冷たいとのことですが、上のお子さんと下のお子さん、それぞれどんなご様子でしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned their attitude is cold. Could you describe how your older child and your younger child are each behaving?

dialogue.content: 親が子供のことを考えるのは当たり前ではないんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Isn't it natural for a parent to think about their children?

dialogue.content: 基本的に話はしてくれません。
dialogue.English: Basically, they don't talk to me.

dialogue.content: 話しかけてもあしらわれるだけです。
dialogue.English: Even if I try to talk to them, I just get brushed off.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれませんね、しかしながらどこまでどう関わるかはそのご家庭それぞれだと思います。
dialogue.English: That may be true, but how much and in what way to be involved varies from family to family.

dialogue.content: なるほど、お二人とも同じということですね。相手の事を思って話かけてもそういった態度で返ってくるとどんなお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so both of them are the same way. How does it make you feel when you try to speak to them out of concern and you're met with that kind of attitude?

dialogue.content: 虚しいです
dialogue.English: It feels empty.

dialogue.content: 悲しい気持ちもありますね
dialogue.English: I feel sad, too.

dialogue.content: 何か不満があれば言ってくれればいいのに、聞いてもなんも無い。って言われるし
dialogue.English: I wish they would just tell me if something's bothering them, but when I ask, they just say, "It's nothing."

dialogue.content: 旦那も同じような感じなのでもうどうしていいのかわかりません
dialogue.English: My husband is the same way, so I don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.content: 確かに、それは虚しさ、悲しさは自然な反応だと思います。気持ちのすれ違いがあるのでしょうか？それとも年代的なものなのでしょうか？（お子さん達に関しては）
dialogue.English: Indeed, feeling empty and sad seems like a natural reaction. Do you think there might be a miscommunication? Or could it be related to their age? (Regarding your children.)

dialogue.content: 分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: お子さんだけでなく旦那様も同じ態度であると、ますます混乱されますよね。
dialogue.English: It must be even more confusing when it's not just your children but your husband acting with the same attitude.

dialogue.content: 旦那様の態度も数年前からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Has your husband's attitude been this way for several years as well?

dialogue.content: 3人がちゃんと不便しないように家の事はやってるつもりなんですけど、や何がダメなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I try to handle all the housework so that the three of them won't be inconvenienced, but... what am I doing wrong?

dialogue.content: 旦那はここ1年くらいです。
dialogue.English: For my husband, it's been about a year.

dialogue.content: お話を伺っている限り、ダメということはないと思いますよ。ご家族の事を優先されて生活されているご状況が伺えます。
dialogue.English: From what you've shared, I don't think you're doing anything wrong. It's clear you're prioritizing your family's needs in your daily life.

dialogue.content: 旦那様に関してはお子さん達より後なのですね。
dialogue.English: So for your husband, it started later than with the children.

dialogue.content: 多分そうだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: 旦那様も話しかけてもあしらったり、冷たいご様子なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does your husband also brush you off or act cold when you try to talk to him?

dialogue.content: そうですね。ほぼ仕事で家にいませんし、ご飯も外で食べてくることが多いです。
dialogue.English: Yes. He's hardly ever home because of work, and he often eats out.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなると話しができる機会は少なそうですね。お仕事がご多忙なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that doesn't leave much opportunity to talk. He must be very busy with work.

dialogue.content: それが嘘かほんとかは知りませんけど。私と顔を合わせたくなくてどっかに行ってる気もします
dialogue.English: I don't know if that's the truth or a lie. I also get the feeling he's going elsewhere just to avoid seeing me.

dialogue.content: こんなに尽くしてるのに何がいけないんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even though I do so much for them, what am I doing wrong?

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、相談者さんとしてはそういった予測をされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you suspect.

dialogue.content: あの人はそういう所あるので
dialogue.English: He has that side to him.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・もしそうだとしたら旦那様に対しどんなお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... If that's the case, how do you feel toward your husband?

dialogue.content: 少し呆れつつも何か不満があれば言ってくれたらいいのにと思います。
dialogue.English: I'd be a little exasperated, but I'd still wish he would just tell me if he had a complaint.

dialogue.content: 確かに、長いお付き合いでも伝えなければ分からないですよね。あまり感情を表にだすことは少ないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's true; even in a long relationship, things can't be understood unless they're communicated. Does he rarely express his emotions openly?

dialogue.content: そうですね。あんまり出しません
dialogue.English: That's right. He doesn't show them much.

dialogue.content: もともと寡黙な方なのですね。直接聞いた事はありますか？例えば、「何か不満はあるの？」とか。
dialogue.English: So he's always been a quiet person, then. Have you ever asked him directly? For example, something like, "Is something bothering you?"

dialogue.content: ありますよ。何も無いと言われて逃げられます
dialogue.English: I have. He just says, "It's nothing," and avoids the topic.

dialogue.content: なので今も仕事を言い訳にしてあまり家に寄り付かないんだと思います
dialogue.English: That's why I think he's using work as an excuse to not come home much these days.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか、そういったやりとりはされたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you've had that kind of exchange.

dialogue.content: 旦那様に対してはどうお考えでしょうか？例えば、話し合いたい、もう関わりたくない等・・・
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts regarding your husband? For example, do you want to talk it over, or do you not want to be involved with him anymore?

dialogue.content: 話し合いたいですよ。旦那に限らず子供たちとも
dialogue.English: I want to talk things over. Not just with my husband, but with my children, too.

dialogue.content: 私の何がいけないのかいってくれなかったら分かりません。
dialogue.English: If they don't tell me what I'm doing wrong, I can't understand.

dialogue.content: 確かに、言ってくれないと解決方法が分かりませんもんね。
dialogue.English: That's true. If they don't tell you, there's no way to figure out how to resolve it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんはご家族にご自身のお気持ちについてお伝えしているにもかかわらず、ご家族からは「なにもない」など不明瞭な返答や冷たい態度をとられるばかりで、こういった状況が数年続いているということで、とてもお辛い思いをおひとりで抱えてらっしゃる様子が伺えます。
dialogue.English: It sounds like even though you communicate your feelings to your family, you only receive vague responses like "it's nothing" or cold attitudes in return. I can tell that you've been shouldering these very painful feelings all by yourself as this situation has continued for several years.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 残念ですが、お時間が近づいてきました。長年のお辛い心境をお話してくださいました。ありがとうございました。ここまでのご相談でいかがだったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Unfortunately, our time is almost up. Thank you for sharing the painful feelings you've held for so many years. How do you feel about our session so far?

dialogue.content: そうですね。状況を話しただけなのでなんとも言えないです。ただ整理は出来ました
dialogue.English: Well, I can't really say, since I only talked about the situation. But it did help me organize my thoughts.

dialogue.content: お気持ちに沿えず申し訳ありません。続きから伺えますので、またよろしければお話に来てください。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry I couldn't fully address your feelings. We can pick up where we left off, so please feel free to come back and talk again if you'd like.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。これで失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. That will be all for today.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様です。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: （遅い時間ありがとうございました。これでロールプレりを終了致します。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time so late in the evening. This concludes the role-play.)
